name: How does AKN Design Group handle the design phase for a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group handle the design phase for a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group approaches the bathroom remodel design phase through an integrated design-build process. This begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, lifestyle, and specific needs. We then utilize CAD-supported layouts to visualize potential floor plans and material selections, ensuring every detail aligns with your desired spa-style retreat. This managed process allows us to unify design planning and construction under one team, providing a single point of coordination and accountability from initial concept to final walkthrough, avoiding the complexities of managing multiple vendors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design phase involves detailed consultations and CAD-supported layouts, unifying design planning and construction under one team for a seamless, coordinated process.
